en: A monochrome postcard showing a small Gothic-style chapel partly obscured by a leafless tree in the foreground and dense foliage on the right. The chapel has steeply pitched roofs, ornate pinnacles, and pointed-arch windows. There is a pile of stones at the base of the building, suggesting construction or renovation. Printed captions in red appear at the bottom in Hungarian and German, along with a small number on the lower left.
